items.label: Bars
items.doc: The closed bars of the instrument and timeframe being computed (oldest first). Volume is the real traded volume where the source has it, otherwise the tick count — as the platform features do.

outputs.name: volume
outputs.doc: real volume, or ticks where there is none

items.formula: OHLC, volume, ticks and spread of each closed bar

items.label: Feature
items.doc: One column of the platform features (Stage 2, intel.engine.features), computed from the same bars.

items.label: Signal score
items.doc: A score from the signal library (Stage 3), −100…+100 per bar, with its own settings.

params.name: settings
params.doc: its settings as JSON, e.g. {"fast": 9, "slow": 21}; empty = the defaults

items.label: Number
items.doc: A fixed number. Type {{name}} to use a graph parameter instead.

items.label: True / false
items.doc: A fixed true or false.

items.label: Side
items.doc: A fixed side: LONG, SHORT, FLAT or HOLD.

items.label: Quote
items.doc: The latest quote of the instrument, as exact decimals.

items.label: Position
items.doc: The current position of the deployment or account in this instrument.

outputs.name: unrealised
outputs.doc: open profit or loss in the account currency

items.label: Account
items.doc: The account the calculation is for.

items.label: Instrument
items.doc: The instrument definition (Setup › Instruments).

items.label: Setting
items.doc: One numeric platform setting (Setup › Settings), as a number for analytics.

items.label: SMA
items.doc: Simple moving average.

items.label: EMA
items.doc: Exponential moving average, seeded with the SMA of the first n values.

items.label: RSI
items.doc: Relative strength index (Wilder).
items.formula: RSI(n=14) = 100 − 100 ÷ (1 + avg gain ÷ avg loss)  (Wilder averages)

items.label: True range
items.doc: max(high − low, |high − previous close|, |low − previous close|).

items.label: ATR
items.doc: Average true range (Wilder).
items.formula: ATR(n=14) = Wilder average of the true range

items.label: Bollinger bands
items.doc: SMA ± k population standard deviations.

items.label: ADX
items.doc: Average directional index with +DI and −DI (Wilder).
items.formula: +DI, −DI = 100 × smoothed ±DM ÷ ATR(14); ADX = Wilder average of 100·|+DI − −DI| ÷ (+DI + −DI)

items.label: Efficiency ratio
items.doc: Net move ÷ total path over n bars (0 = noise, 1 = straight line).

items.label: Realised volatility
items.doc: Annualised standard deviation of log returns over n bars, in %.
items.formula: RV = 100 × √(sample variance of log returns over 20 bars × bars per year)

items.label: Range position
items.doc: Where the close sits in the n-bar high–low range (0 = at the low, 100 = at the high, 50 when flat).
items.formula: 100 × (close − lowest low) ÷ (highest high − lowest low) over 20 bars (this bar included)

items.label: MACD
items.doc: EMA(fast) − EMA(slow), its EMA(signal), and the histogram.
items.formula: line = EMA(12) − EMA(26); signal = EMA(9) of line; hist = line − signal

items.label: Stochastic
items.doc: %K = where the close sits in the n-bar range, smoothed; %D = its average.
items.formula: %K = SMA(3) of 100 × (close − lowest low) ÷ (highest high − lowest low) over 14; %D = SMA(3) of %K

items.label: Donchian channel
items.doc: Highest high and lowest low of the last n bars, including this one.
items.formula: upper = max(high, 20 bars), lower = min(low, 20 bars) — this bar included

items.label: Z-score
items.doc: (close − SMA) ÷ population standard deviation over n bars (0 when flat).

items.label: VWAP
items.doc: Volume-weighted average of the typical price over n bars.
items.formula: VWAP = Σ(typical × volume) ÷ Σ volume over 20 bars, typical = (h + l + c) ÷ 3

items.label: OBV
items.doc: On-balance volume: volume added on up closes, subtracted on down closes.
items.formula: OBVₜ = OBVₜ₋₁ ± volumeₜ (sign of closeₜ − closeₜ₋₁)

items.label: Rate of change
items.doc: 100 × (close ÷ close n bars ago − 1).

items.label: Shift
items.doc: The value k bars ago (k = 0 is this bar). A future bar cannot be asked for.

items.label: Rolling window
items.doc: A statistic of the last n bars — this bar included, or the n bars before it.

params.name: fn
params.doc: mean, sum, min, max, stdev (sample), stdev_pop, rank (0…100)

params.name: exclude_current
params.doc: use the n bars before this one (a breakout compares with them)

items.label: Difference
items.doc: The change over k bars: xₜ − xₜ₋ₖ.

items.label: Percent change
items.doc: 100 × (xₜ ÷ xₜ₋ₖ − 1); missing when xₜ₋ₖ is 0.

items.label: Log return
items.doc: ln(xₜ ÷ xₜ₋ₖ); missing when either is 0 or less.

items.label: Cumulative
items.doc: Running total, highest or lowest from the first bar supplied (missing bars are skipped).

items.label: Normalise by ATR
items.doc: x ÷ (scale × ATR): a distance in ATRs, the same on every instrument.

items.label: Add
items.doc: a + b on every bar.

items.label: Subtract
items.doc: a − b on every bar.

items.label: Multiply
items.doc: a × b on every bar.

items.label: Divide
items.doc: a ÷ b on every bar.

items.label: Function
items.doc: abs, sqrt, log (natural), exp, negate or sign of x on every bar.

items.label: Min / max
items.doc: The smaller or larger of a and b.

items.label: Clamp
items.doc: x kept within lo…hi (a score is clamped to −100…+100).

items.label: Round
items.doc: x rounded to a number of decimals (half to even, as Python and the platform round).

items.label: Expression
items.doc: One line of the formula language over named inputs (mark a true/false input name:bool): + − × ÷ ^, comparisons, and/or/not, x[t-k] for k bars ago, and abs, min, max, clamp, sqrt, log, exp, round, sign, if, coalesce. No other names, no code.

params.name: inputs
params.doc: the input names, comma-separated, e.g. "fast, slow, atr" (a true/false input as "crossed:bool")

items.label: Compare
items.doc: a compared with b on every bar.

items.label: Crosses
items.doc: a crosses b on this bar (it was on the other side, or level, on the bar before).

items.label: And
items.doc: True when both are true.

items.label: Or
items.doc: True when either is true.

items.label: Not
items.doc: The opposite.

items.label: If
items.doc: then when the condition holds, otherwise else.

items.label: Between
items.doc: lo ≤ x ≤ hi (or strictly inside).

items.label: Side from score
items.doc: LONG at or above +threshold, SHORT at or below −threshold, otherwise FLAT (the signal library's direction).
items.formula: LONG if score ≥ 20.0, SHORT if ≤ −20.0, else FLAT

items.label: Side with hysteresis
items.doc: Enter LONG at +entry or SHORT at −entry; leave when the score comes back to ±exit. Holds the side in between, so a score near the line does not flip every bar.

items.label: Latch (target)
items.doc: Go LONG when "long" is true, SHORT when "short" is true, otherwise hold the last target (the strategy algorithms' state machine). Long only: a short event only closes a long; short only: the reverse.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.doc: true on the bar the target changes

items.formula: target ← LONG on long, SHORT on short, else held (both)

items.label: Weighted sum
items.doc: Σ wᵢ·xᵢ ÷ Σ|wᵢ| — a blend that stays on the inputs' scale.

params.name: missing
params.doc: skip: leave a missing input out; missing: the result is missing

items.formula: out = (1·in1 + 1·in2) ÷ 2  (a missing input is left out, with its weight)

items.label: Vote
items.doc: Each input votes LONG (≥ +threshold), SHORT (≤ −threshold) or abstains; out = 100 × (longs − shorts) ÷ inputs.

items.label: Consensus
items.doc: Share of the inputs on the same side as their average, in %, signed by that side.

items.label: Rank
items.doc: The rank of each input among the inputs on each bar (1 = highest; ties share a rank).

items.label: Last value (number)
items.doc: The value on the last bar (the bar being decided).

items.label: Last value (true/false)
items.doc: The value on the last bar (the bar being decided).

items.label: Last value (side)
items.doc: The value on the last bar (the bar being decided).

items.label: To decimal
items.doc: An analytics number made an exact decimal money, price or quantity: rounded to the places given, with the rounding named. The only way a float reaches a decimal port.
items.formula: out = round(x, 5 places, HALF_EVEN) as an exact price

items.label: Signal score
items.doc: The graph's result for Stage 3: a score per bar within −100…+100, plus the values shown with it (name them in "show" and wire them in).

params.name: show
params.doc: names of extra values shown with the score, e.g. "fast, slow, atr14"

items.label: Feature value
items.doc: The graph's result for Stage 2: a number per bar.

items.label: Strategy rule
items.doc: The graph's result for Stage 4: a target side per bar, a strength and a reason.

params.name: reason
params.doc: why the rule holds, shown with every decision

items.label: Order size
items.doc: The graph's result for Stage 5: an exact decimal quantity and how it was worked out.

items.label: Stop and target
items.doc: The graph's result for protective orders: exact decimal prices.

items.label: Risk refusal
items.doc: The graph's result for Stage 5: refuse on the last bar, with the reason. It can only refuse — the built-in limits always run.

items.label: Allocation
items.doc: The graph's result for Stage 6: non-negative weights that sum to 1.

items.label: Measure
items.doc: The graph's result for a portfolio, execution or post-trade view: a named number.

Market data.name: Bar (OHLC) from ticks

inputs.name: offset_ms

steps.name: score

steps.label: quality score

inputs.name: median_mid
inputs.doc: median mid of the other sources

inputs.name: sum_close
inputs.doc: Σ close of the last n bars

steps.name: tr
steps.expr: max(high - low, abs(high - prev_close), abs(low - prev_close))
steps.label: true range

inputs.name: below
inputs.doc: of the last 100 bars, how many had a lower atr_pct

inputs.name: var
inputs.doc: sample variance of 1-bar log returns, 20 bars

inputs.name: volume
inputs.doc: volume of the bar (real, else ticks)

inputs.name: m1_bars
inputs.doc: M1 bars in the H1 bucket

inputs.name: needed
inputs.doc: M1 bars for a complete H1 bar

steps.name: use_broker
steps.label: broker bar used when as complete

inputs.name: channel_high
inputs.doc: highest high of the previous n bars

inputs.name: sum_scores
inputs.doc: Σ scores of the active signals

inputs.name: cov
inputs.doc: covariance of the two score series

inputs.name: ic
inputs.doc: Spearman rank correlation score vs h-bar return

Signals.name: Research: hit rate, quintiles, turnover, cost

inputs.name: hits

inputs.name: entry_high

steps.name: change

inputs.name: trough

nodes.name: Bar (OHLC) from ticks
nodes.equation: close = last_bid; average spread = sum_spread / ticks

nodes.name: Latency
nodes.equation: broker time in UTC = broker_ms - offset_ms; latency, ms = receive_ms - broker_utc

nodes.name: Feed quality score (0–100)
nodes.equation: deviation penalty = if(abs(dev_bp) > dev_limit, 15, 0); quality score = max(0, 100 - p_lat - p_gap - p_frozen - p_spread - p_spike - p_dev)

nodes.name: Spike
nodes.equation: move above k·σ = abs(move) > k * sigma; spike = big and reverses

nodes.name: Deviation from other sources
nodes.equation: deviation, bp = 10000 * (mid - median_mid) / median_mid

nodes.name: SMA(n)
nodes.equation: SMA = sum_close / n

nodes.name: EMA(n) — ema20, ema50, ema200
nodes.equation: α = 2 / (n + 1); EMA = prev_ema + alpha * (close - prev_ema)

nodes.name: RSI(14) — rsi14
nodes.equation: RS = gain / loss; RSI = 100 - 100 / (1 + rs)

nodes.name: ATR(14) — atr14, atr_pct
nodes.equation: ATR (Wilder) = (prev_atr * (n - 1) + tr) / n; ATR % of price = 100 * atr / close

nodes.name: ATR% rank — atr_pct_rank100
nodes.equation: percentile 0–100 = 100 * below / (count - 1)

nodes.name: Bollinger(20, 2) — bb_mid, bb_upper, bb_lower, bb_width_pct
nodes.equation: lower band = mid - k * sigma; width % = 100 * (upper - lower) / mid

nodes.name: ADX(14), +DI, −DI
nodes.equation: DX = 100 * abs(pdi - mdi) / (pdi + mdi); ADX = (prev_adx * (n - 1) + dx) / n

nodes.name: Efficiency ratio — er20
nodes.equation: efficiency ratio = if(path == 0, 0, net / path)

nodes.name: Realised volatility — rv20_pct
nodes.equation: annualised % = 100 * sqrt(var * bars_per_year)

nodes.name: Range position — range_pos20
nodes.equation: position 0–100 = if(high20 == low20, 50, 100 * (close - low20) / (high20 - low20))

nodes.name: Returns — ret_1_pct, ret_20_pct
nodes.equation: return % = 100 * (close / close_k - 1)

nodes.name: MACD(12, 26, 9) — macd, macd_signal, macd_hist
nodes.equation: signal line = prev_signal + 2 / (n_signal + 1) * (line - prev_signal); histogram = line - signal

nodes.name: Stochastic(14, 3, 3) — stoch_k, stoch_d
nodes.equation: %K = SMA₃(raw) = (raw1 + raw2 + raw3) / 3; %D = SMA₃(%K) = (k + k1 + k2) / 3

nodes.name: Donchian(20) — donchian_high20, donchian_low20
nodes.equation: Donchian low = lowest; middle = (upper + lower) / 2

nodes.name: Z-score(20) — zscore20
nodes.equation: z-score = if(sigma == 0, 0, (close - mean) / sigma)

nodes.name: Volume — tick_volume, volume, rel_volume20
nodes.equation: relative volume = volume / avg20

nodes.name: VWAP(20) — vwap20, vwap_dev_pct
nodes.equation: VWAP = sum_pv / sum_v; distance % = 100 * (close / vwap - 1)

nodes.name: OBV
nodes.equation: OBV = prev_obv + volume * sign(change)

nodes.name: Regime
nodes.equation: RANGE = adx < 20; trend confidence = 0.6 * clamp((adx - 20) / 20, 0, 1) + 0.4 * clamp(er / 0.6, 0, 1)

nodes.name: Volatility state
nodes.equation: LOW = rank <= 20; NORMAL = not high and not low

nodes.name: Screener attention (0–100)
nodes.equation: direction = clamp(adx / 50, 0, 1); attention = 100 * quality * cost * (0.5 * movement + 0.5 * direction)

nodes.name: Timeframes
nodes.result: broker bar used when as complete
nodes.equation: M1-built bar complete = m1_bars >= needed; broker bar used when as complete = broker_complete

nodes.name: EMA trend (EMA_TREND)
nodes.equation: gap = ema_fast - ema_slow; score = clamp(100 * gap / (scale * atr14), -100, 100)

nodes.name: SMA trend (SMA_TREND)
nodes.equation: gap = sma_fast - sma_slow; score = clamp(100 * gap / (scale * atr14), -100, 100)

nodes.name: MACD momentum (MACD_MOMENTUM)
nodes.equation: score = clamp(100 * histogram / (scale * atr14), -100, 100)

nodes.name: RSI reversion (RSI_REVERSION)
nodes.equation: score (high RSI → short) = clamp(-2 * (rsi - 50), -100, 100)

nodes.name: RSI momentum (RSI_MOMENTUM)
nodes.equation: score = clamp(2 * (rsi - 50), -100, 100)

nodes.name: Bollinger reversion (BOLLINGER_REVERSION)
nodes.equation: z = (close - middle) / sigma; score = clamp(-100 * z / deviations, -100, 100)

nodes.name: Z-score reversion (ZSCORE_REVERSION)
nodes.equation: score = clamp(-100 * z / zmax, -100, 100)

nodes.name: Donchian breakout (DONCHIAN_BREAKOUT)
nodes.equation: position = if(channel_high == channel_low, 0.5, (close - channel_low) / (channel_high - channel_low)); score = clamp(200 * (position - 0.5), -100, 100)

nodes.name: Momentum (t-stat) (MOMENTUM_TSTAT)
nodes.equation: t-statistic = if(sigma_1bar == 0, 0, log_return / (sigma_1bar * sqrt(n))); score = clamp(100 * tstat / scale, -100, 100)

nodes.name: Stochastic reversion (STOCHASTIC_REVERSION)
nodes.equation: score = clamp(-2 * (percent_k - 50), -100, 100)

nodes.name: ADX direction (ADX_DIRECTION)
nodes.equation: ADX factor = min(1, adx / full_at); score = clamp(100 * di_balance * factor, -100, 100)

nodes.name: VWAP reversion (VWAP_REVERSION)
nodes.equation: distance = close - vwap; score = clamp(-100 * distance / (scale * atr14), -100, 100)

nodes.name: Signal side (library)
nodes.equation: SHORT = score <= -threshold; FLAT = not long and not short

nodes.name: Consensus (composite of an instrument)
nodes.equation: composite = sum_scores / n; agreement % = 100 * same_sign / n

nodes.name: Flip
nodes.equation: flip recorded = dir_now != dir_before

nodes.name: Signal correlation
nodes.equation: Pearson r = cov / (sd_a * sd_b); counts twice in a blend = abs(r) >= 0.8

nodes.name: Research: information coefficient
nodes.equation: t-stat = ic * sqrt((n - 2) / (1 - ic ^ 2))

nodes.name: Research: hit rate, quintiles, turnover, cost
nodes.equation: turnover per bar = sum_dscore / bars / 200; cost, bp = 10000 * avg_spread / avg_close

nodes.name: Research: verdict
nodes.equation: PREDICTIVE = abs(ic) >= 0.03 and abs(tstat) >= 2 and edge_bp > cost_bp; WEAK = not predictive and abs(tstat) >= 1

nodes.name: Moving-average crossover (SMA)
nodes.equation: crossed below → SHORT = fast_before >= slow_before and fast < slow; strength = clamp(round(100 * abs(fast - slow) / atr), 10, 100)

nodes.name: EMA crossover
nodes.equation: crossed below → SHORT = fast_before >= slow_before and fast < slow; strength = clamp(round(100 * abs(fast - slow) / atr), 10, 100)

nodes.name: RSI mean reversion
nodes.equation: crosses back below upper → SHORT = rsi_before > upper and rsi <= upper; strength (long) = clamp(2 * (exit_level - min(rsi_before, rsi)), 10, 100)

nodes.name: Donchian channel breakout
nodes.equation: breakout down → SHORT = close < entry_low; strength (long) = clamp(100 * (close - entry_high) / atr, 10, 100)

nodes.name: Bollinger band reversion
nodes.equation: back inside from below → LONG = close_before < lower_before and close >= lower; strength = clamp(200 * abs(close - middle) / (upper - lower), 10, 100)

nodes.name: Rule builder (any feature)
nodes.equation: condition 2 = ema_fast > ema_slow; every long-entry condition holds = cond1 and cond2

nodes.name: Signal blend (Stage 3 signals combined)
nodes.equation: back inside ±exit → FLAT = abs(combined) < exit; strength = clamp(abs(combined), 10, 100)

nodes.name: Calculation graph (an approved strategy-rule graph)
nodes.equation: target differs from the one held = target_long and held_short; strength = if(change, graph_strength, 0)

nodes.name: Strategy signal born
nodes.equation: target changed = target_now != target_before; a signal is born = changed and not first_bar

nodes.name: Check: price fresh
nodes.equation: price fresh = age_s <= max_age

nodes.name: Check: spread
nodes.equation: spread as % of ATR = 100 * (ask - bid) / atr; spread acceptable = spread_pct <= max_pct

nodes.name: Check: market open, event risk, strength, duplicate
nodes.equation: all checks pass = market_open and not event_near and strength >= min_strength and not duplicate

nodes.name: Decision
nodes.equation: wanted position = target * size; order quantity (+ buy, − sell) = wanted - position

nodes.name: Realign
nodes.equation: retry = not executed and position != target and not working and attempts < max_attempts

nodes.name: Sizing: fixed quantity
nodes.equation: quantity = q * weight

nodes.name: Sizing: fixed value
nodes.equation: quantity = notional * weight / (price * contract * fx)

nodes.name: Sizing: % of equity at an ATR stop
nodes.equation: stop distance = k * atr; quantity = risk_money / (stop_distance * contract * fx)

nodes.name: Lot rules
nodes.equation: rounded down to the step = floor(quantity / step) * step; below the minimum → refused = rounded < minimum

nodes.name: Protective exits
nodes.equation: stop (long) = entry - stop_atr * atr; target (long) = entry + take_atr * atr

nodes.name: Backtest fill
nodes.equation: buy fill = next_open + spread_ticks * tick; commission = commission * lots

nodes.name: Backtest metrics
nodes.equation: Sharpe = mean_ret / sd_ret * sqrt(bars_per_year); profit factor = gross_win / abs(gross_loss)

nodes.name: Walk-forward
nodes.equation: efficiency % = 100 * oos / is_score; ROBUST = efficiency >= 50 and oos > 0

nodes.name: Drift
nodes.equation: tolerance factor = 1 - tol / 100; DRIFT = live_win < bt_win * f or live_pf < bt_pf * f or (live_avg < 0 and 0 < bt_avg)

nodes.name: Kill switches
nodes.equation: any switch engaged = firm or account or strategy or instrument or deployment; new risk refused = engaged and not closing

nodes.name: Limits (tightest of firm, account, strategy, instrument, deployment)
nodes.equation: within every limit = qty <= max_order and abs(position_after) <= max_position and working < max_open and last_minute < per_minute

nodes.name: Loss and drawdown
nodes.equation: drawdown % = 100 * (peak - equity) / peak; drawdown within limit = drawdown <= max_dd

nodes.name: Exposure
nodes.equation: gross exposure = other_gross + value; within exposure limits = gross <= max_gross and value <= max_instrument

nodes.name: Margin and leverage
nodes.equation: leverage used = gross / equity; within margin and leverage = margin_pct <= max_margin_pct and lev <= max_leverage

nodes.name: Price deviation (fat finger)
nodes.equation: distance from the market % = 100 * abs(price - mid) / mid; within the limit = dev_pct <= max_pct

nodes.name: Stale price
nodes.equation: price fresh enough = age_s <= max_age or real_closing

nodes.name: Value at Risk (historical)
nodes.equation: VaR = -worst_k; expected shortfall = -mean_worst

nodes.name: Stress
nodes.equation: stressed P&L = value * shock_pct / 100

nodes.name: Average cost
nodes.equation: new average (adding) = (qty0 * avg0 + q * price) / (qty0 + q)

nodes.name: Realised P&L
nodes.equation: realised (instrument currency) = closed * (fill - avg) * side * contract

nodes.name: Unrealised P&L
nodes.equation: unrealised (account currency) = qty * (mid - avg) * contract * fx

nodes.name: Equity and drawdown
nodes.equation: equity = capital + realised + unrealised; drawdown % = 100 * (peak - equity) / peak

nodes.name: Partition equity
nodes.equation: partition equity = capital + realised + unrealised

nodes.name: Allocation
nodes.equation: WEIGHT (partition 1) = total * w1 / (w1 + w2); RISK_PARITY (partition 1) = total * (1 / sd1) / (1 / sd1 + 1 / sd2)

nodes.name: Copy size
nodes.equation: FIXED_RATIO = floor(fill * ratio / step) * step; EQUITY_RATIO = floor(fill * f_equity / m_equity * ratio / step) * step

nodes.name: Attribution
nodes.equation: share % = 100 * group / all_abs

nodes.name: Handoff (per deployment)
nodes.equation: waits in the queue = approve and minutes_waiting < window; EXPIRED = approve and minutes_waiting >= window

nodes.name: Executing a waiting decision
nodes.equation: quantity = if(chosen > 0, min(chosen, abs(order)), abs(order)); rounded down to the step = floor(qty / step) * step

nodes.name: Order terms
nodes.equation: PASSIVE buy = bid - n * tick; PASSIVE sell = ask + n * tick

nodes.name: Client order ID
nodes.result: the same intent gives the same ID → never a second order
nodes.equation: the same intent gives the same ID → never a second order = same_seed

nodes.name: Paper fill price
nodes.equation: buy fill = ask + slip_ticks * tick; sell fill = bid - slip_ticks * tick

nodes.name: Slippage
nodes.equation: buy slippage (positive = worse) = fill - arrival_ask; sell slippage = arrival_bid - fill

nodes.name: Latency
nodes.equation: latency, ms = fill_ms - submitted_ms

nodes.name: Routing
nodes.equation: LOWEST_COST: B = ask_b + slip_b; picks A = cost_a <= cost_b

nodes.name: UNKNOWN look-up
nodes.equation: → working = not found_fill and found_open; → cancelled = not found_fill and not found_open and found_cancel

nodes.name: Execution algorithm child (TWAP / VWAP / POV / iceberg)
nodes.equation: POV target = min(q, pct / 100 * volume); next child (TWAP) = floor(max(0, twap_target - filled - working) / step) * step

nodes.name: Position reconciliation
nodes.equation: difference = abs(corei - broker); break = diff > tolerance

nodes.name: Internal reconciliation
nodes.equation: break = position != fills

nodes.name: TCA slippage
nodes.equation: slippage, bp = 10000 * slippage / arrival; cost, money = slippage * qty * contract * fx

nodes.name: Fill rate, refusal rate, latency
nodes.equation: fill rate % = 100 * filled / ordered; refusal rate % = 100 * rejected / orders

nodes.name: Trade (round trip)
nodes.equation: MFE (long) = best - entry; MAE (long) = entry - worst
